purpose: Dates that run the sunday_ph train timetable instead of the weekday one (F27).
provenance: Hand-entered from Singapore's gazetted public holidays. This is NOT derived from a feed and has not been checked against a primary source in this repo.

It cannot be derived here: scripts/build_data.py keys headways off the GTFS service_id prefix (SERVICE_WEEKDAY / SATURDAY / SUNDAY_PH) and never reads calendar_dates.txt, so nothing in the committed data knows which Tuesday is Deepavali. If calendar_dates.txt is ever shipped, rebuild this from it and drop the hand entry.
Before relying on this for a real journey, confirm every 'lunar' row against the Ministry of Manpower gazette.
erring_direction: A sunday_ph headway is larger than the weekday one at the same hour (4.0-5.4 min against 2.5 at Bedok).
So a date wrongly included over-estimates her wait, and a date wrongly left out under-estimates it. When in doubt, include: the plan should be early, not late.

basis_key.fixed: the same calendar date every year
basis_key.computed: follows a rule (Good Friday is two days before Easter Sunday)
basis_key.lunar: set by a lunar or Islamic calendar - confirm against the gazette
basis_key.in_lieu: the Monday given when the holiday itself fell on a Sunday
